# `aitbc config unset`

Remove a configuration key from the local or global config file.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config unset [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--key` | text | — | yes | The Key. |
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Unset from global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config unset --key <key>
```
